Class CreateCityController

java.lang.Object
controller.CreateCityController
public class CreateCityController extends Object
This class is responsible for the process of creating cities and assigning blocks to them. It validates mechanisms for city creation and block placement to ensure proper consistency with the associated map and repository. This class interacts with the MapRepository and CityRepository to perform operations such as: name validation; map existence checks; and city/block assignment.

  • Method Details

    • validateNameMap

      public CreateCityController.NameMapError validateNameMap(String name, String map)
      Validates the uniqueness of a city name within the context of a specified map by checking if the city name is unique in the context of a specified map.
      Parameters:
      name - The name of the city to validate. Cannot be null or empty.
      map - The name of the map in which the validation is to be performed. Cannot be null or empty.
      Returns:
      A NameMapError enumeration value representing the result of the validation: - NameMapError.MAP_NOT_FOUND: If the specified map does not exist in the repository. - NameMapError.NAME_DUPLICATE: If the city name is not unique within the specified map. - NameMapError.OK: If the validation is successful.

    • validateCenter

      public CreateCityController.CenterError validateCenter(String name, String map, int x, int y)
      Validates the center position for creating a city on a specified map and checks constraints such as boundaries, position availability, and block uniqueness.
      Parameters:
      name - The name of the city to be validated. Cannot be null or empty.
      map - The name of the map where the validation is performed. Cannot be null or empty.
      x - The x-coordinate of the proposed city center on the map. Must be within map boundaries.
      y - The y-coordinate of the proposed city center on the map. Must be within map boundaries.
      Returns:
      A CenterError enumeration value indicating the result of the validation: - CenterError.OUT_OF_BOUNDS: If the coordinates are outside the map boundaries. - CenterError.POSITION_TAKEN: If the position is already occupied by a city. - CenterError.BLOCK_PRESENT: If a block already exists at the specified position. - CenterError.OK: If the center position is valid.

    • validateBlock

      public CreateCityController.BlockError validateBlock(String map, HouseBlock b)
      Validates the placement of a house block within a specified map according to constraints: map boundaries; block position uniqueness; collision with existing city centers.
      Parameters:
      map - The name of the map where the block's placement is to be validated. Cannot be null or empty.
      b - The HouseBlock to validate, representing its position within the map. Must not be null and should have valid coordinates.
      Returns:
      A BlockError enumeration value indicating the result of the validation: - BlockError.OUT_OF_BOUNDS: If the block's coordinates are outside the map boundaries. - BlockError.COLLIDES_CITY_CENTER: If the block collides with an existing city center. - BlockError.COLLIDES_BLOCK: If the block's position is not unique within the map. - BlockError.OK: If the block placement is valid.

    • createCity

      public City createCity(String name, String map, int x, int y)
      Creates a new city with the specified name, map, and center coordinates by validating the city name and map, as well as the center position.
      Parameters:
      name - The name of the city to be created. Must be unique within the given map.
      map - The name of the map where the city will be created. Must exist in the repository.
      x - The x-coordinate of the city's center on the map. Must be within map boundaries.
      y - The y-coordinate of the city's center on the map. Must be within map boundaries.
      Returns:
      The City object representing the newly created city.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the city name, map, or center coordinates fail validation.

    • addBlockManual

      public boolean addBlockManual(City city, HouseBlock b)
      Adds a house block manually to the specified city if the block passes validation.
      Parameters:
      city - The City to which the house block should be added. Cannot be null.
      b - The HouseBlock to be added to the city. Must not be null and should have valid coordinates.
      Returns:
      true if the block is successfully added after validation; false otherwise.

    • assignBlocksAuto

      public void assignBlocksAuto(City city, int count, double sigma)
      Automatically assigns a specified number of house blocks to a city. The method uses Gaussian distribution around the city's center to determine the positions of house blocks and ensures that every block passes validation before being added.
      Parameters:
      city - The City object to which the house blocks will be added. Must not be null.
      count - The number of house blocks to be assigned. Must be a non-negative integer.
      sigma - The standard deviation used for Gaussian distribution to calculate house block positions. Must be positive.
